penalty.note: 9% of the tax when not paid by the due date, 19% after the month following and 29% after the second month, with a $5 minimum.

unemployment.note: $25 per late tax or wage report.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Greater of $1,301 (from July 1, 2026) or twice the premiums due for failing to register, with a daily penalty for violating a stop-work order.
